name: Soncino (Italy)
description: White field with two red horizontal stripes (the arms of Soncino).
history: Municipal flag of Soncino, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 27 November 1985.
